application.name: IT Help Desk
application.description: A complete IT support ticketing system built as a NetPad Application. Includes ticket submission (traditional and conversational AI-powered), ticket search and management, automated routing workflows, priority-based escalation, and Slack notifications. This is a production-ready Application that solves the job-to-be-done: 'Manage internal IT support requests efficiently without enterprise ticketing software.'

manifest.name: IT Help Desk
manifest.description: Complete IT support ticketing system with ticket submission, search & management, conditional fields, priority-based routing, automated notifications, and Slack escalation for critical tickets
manifest.author: NetPad Examples

instructions.import: This is a NetPad Application that groups related forms, workflows, and connections into a complete solution. Import this Application into your NetPad project to get a fully-functional IT help desk system.
setup: 1. Create a new Application in NetPad or import this bundle
2. Configure your MongoDB connection (the Application will store submissions in your specified collection)
3. Customize department options, issue categories, and contact preferences to match your organization
4. Configure the workflow email addresses (change 'it-support@yourcompany.com' to your IT team's email)
5. Set up Slack integration and update the '#it-critical-alerts' channel name
6. Create an Application Release to version your configuration
7. Publish the Application to your organization or the marketplace (optional)
8. The forms and workflows are already connected within the Application
customization: Modify the department dropdown options to match your organization structure
Add or remove issue categories and their corresponding conditional fields
Customize urgency levels and response time expectations
Edit email templates in the workflow to match your organization's tone
Add additional workflow actions (e.g., create tickets in Jira, log to spreadsheet)
Configure form theme and branding to match your brand
Customize search form filters and result columns for your IT team's needs
Use the Application Permissions feature to control who can edit forms/workflows
Create Application Releases to version your changes with semantic versioning

connections.description: Triggers ticket routing workflow when a ticket is submitted
